lines:
▪ Don't lose them!! Surround them!!
▪ Yeah!! Show them no mercy!!
The sound of rifles echoed in the vast underground space.
While we had Hebiko shield us from the gunfire with her octopus tentacles, we looked for openings and fought back.
What the hell are they talking about, damnit!? I paid quite a bit of money!!
And Sana-san was cutting down the Armed Refugees while incessantly complaining.
Do you know how much I could've gone drinking with that money!? Huh!?
(And now this... Gotta hand it to her...)
No wonder she had Asagi-sensei's trust.

Sana-san was displaying her brilliant, and I suppose you could say traditional, swordsmanship, and no one would think this was the same person who had been drunkenly harassing us just a short time ago.
Th-This is bad, Fuma!! There's more and more enemies coming!!!
Just how many people called this underground area home?
The sporadic emergence of rifle-toting Armed Refugees from the darkness wouldn't stop.
Yeah, we're gonna get surrounded if it continues like this!! Sana-san, let's retreat for now and reorganize! Hebiko, the smokescreen!!
With a whoosh, the smokescreenーHebiko's octopus inkーwas spread out in front of the Armed Refugees.

▪ Ugh!? What is this!?
▪ I-I can't see anything!!
Oohh!! Nice, Hebiko!! Alright guys, retreat for now!!

▪ They haven't gone far!!
▪ There's a big reward if we kill 'em! Don't let 'em get away!!
A group of Armed Refugees ran right past the shadow we were hiding in.
It seemed they were searching for us extensively, so we couldn't move at all.
I thought they would stop looking for us if we got out of their territory... but I guess they wouldn't go that easy on us.
In fact, it seemed they even had been offered a reward for killing us for some reason.
Sana-san, does anything come to mind? Anything that could cause them to hold a grudge against us.
Nope, I can't think of anything!! I don't know what's going on here either...
As I asked in hushed tones, Sana-san replied with a puzzled look on her face.
You did pay them, didn't you?
I did. This has never happened before. I've never had any issues getting to Yomihara until now...
(An unexpected situation crops up just this time...?)
It didn't seem like that kind of crew would let an opportunity to make money slip away for no reason.
And the "reward" they were talking about was also bothering me.
Unless you got drunk and picked a fight with them...
I-I mean, I'm just saying it's a possibility... Anyways...
Another thing I can think of is that maybe someone else has appeared who's willing to pay them more...?
Who knows. I can't really say anything since there's not enough information. But one thing's for sure: Our plan is thoroughly messed up now.
From the looks of it, it didn't seem like they would let us pass through their territory easily.
Oh man... If we can't get through their territory, getting to Yomihara will be a real pain...
R-Really...!? Can't we just sneak around the edges or something...?
Hmmm... I'm not too keen on that. They can see very well in the dark.
I mean, there is another route, but... that way is, well, yeah...
Even Sana-san couldn't decide on what to do.
Th-Then... Hey, Fuma!? What should we do!?
(How can we get through their territory safely while also trying to figure out the reason for their change of heart?)
After some thought, I came up with an easy way to accomplish both.
Alright!! Let's throw caution to the wind and try "that"!!
